|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Flammability''' is a [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, making them less [[Resistance|resistant]] to [[fire damage]] and gives damage hit more chance to [[ignite]]. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== * '''Negative Resistances:''' This curse can cause resistance values to dip into the negative, if the base values are low enough. This will have the effect of increasing the damage above values listed on the [[character screen]]. For example, a monster that has 0% fire resistance and then is inflicted with level 1 Flammability will have -17% resistance. Thus take 17% more (multiplicative) fire damage than the [[spell]] or [[attack]] would normally cause. * Flammability can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}.[[File:Flammability aura screenshot.png|thumbnail|right|The aura version of Flammability]] ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Added

Resistance |c2_header = Cursed enemies have x% to Fire Resistance |c2_pattern_extract = Cursed enemies have (%-%d+)%% to Fire Resistance |c2_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related modifiers== The following spawnable modifiers are related to Flammability: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%flammability%" AND domain = 1 AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |tags=1 }} ===Synthesis implicit=== These Synthesis implicits are currently only found on Synthesis uniques only or on rare/magic/normal [[legacy variant|legacy]] items in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%flammability%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 }} ===Delve drop-only modifiers=== The following mods can only be found in specific nodes in the [[Azurite Mine]]. {{Modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where=(mod_stats.id LIKE "%curse_on_hit_level_flammability%") AND mods.domain=1 AND mods.generation_type=2 AND mods.name="of the Underground" |stat_text=1 |required_level=1 |generation_type=1 }} ===Legacy=== The following mods are spawn disabled. They can only be found on [[legacy variant|legacy]] items in permanent leagues. {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%flammability%" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Delve%" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |generation_type=1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Flammability}} ==Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%flammability%" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes Ignite on Cursed enemies to have 0-20% increased Duration (previously 0-10%). }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| *Now has {{c|mod|Base duration is (8-11.8) seconds}} (previously (9-10.9) seconds). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed enemies have -(17-36)% to Fire Resistance}} (previously -(25-44)%). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| ''All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.'' * Hexes apply a curse in an area and, when manually cast, apply an amount of Doom per second to cursed enemies up to a maximum. Doom increases the effect of the afflicted curse and stacks additively with modifiers to increased Curse effect. * Curses applied by casting '''Flammability''' skill now gain 10 Doom per second. * Now causes Hexed enemies to have 25% chance to be Ignited at all gem levels (from 10% at gem level 1, up to 14% at gem level 20). }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Resistance reduction increased by 5% at all levels. Mana cost reduced at all levels. Area of effect increases per gem level reduced, but the base area of effect has been increased by 37.5% (from 16 to 22). Normalised the increased duration per gem level. Flammability now grants 0.5% increased burn duration on cursed enemies per 1% of quality (was 1% per 1% quality). }} {{Version history table row|0.9.13| * Flammability has been added to the game }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{math|formula= \begin{align} \text{dmg}_{\text{red} } & = (1 - \text{Resistance}) * \text{dmg} \end{align} }}}} {{Navbox Skills}} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
